notes.title: Tinker Racer update v1.1.0
notes.content:
More friends have shown up bringing their cars! It was not easy to convince Mom and Dad to put more toys in the house. But we did it!

Changes in v1.1.0:

- 8 players available on Free for All matches (4 on controllers + 4 on keyboard).

Bug fixes:

- Several improvements on controllers usage and detection. Please, if you still have any problem (specially now with 8 players), post on our forum;
- Camera issues at race start fixed.

- Camera issues at race start fixed.

notes.title: Tinker Racers update v1.0.1
notes.content:
As we wanted to make it possible for 4 players to be able to play on the same keyboard (even without any controllers), we needed to take a slightly different approach of how the player's input are implemented in other games. This brought us countless problems that we did not expect. On one hand, we had feedback from several players who were having problems with the standard configuration (4 players with 4 controllers) or when trying to play via Remote Play. On the other hand, we had players crazy enough to have fun with our proposal of 4 players on the same keyboard since the beginning, so taking that out was not an option. We were not willing to let any of the audiences down.
After many interactions, we believe we have arrived at a solution to maintain the 2 proposals simultaneously. Please, if you ever got any problem with 4 controllers and/or Remote Play Together, consider giving it another try! And if someone still has a problem with it, give your feedback on the forum in the topic we created especially for this.
Thanks!

Changes in v1.0.1:
[list]
[*] Controllers now have to be activated through START / MENU button to be able to play with it;
[*] Performance improvements to reduce camera stuttering for most users.
[/list]

tags.bug: Performance improvements to reduce camera stuttering for most users.

notes.title: Tinker Racers Official Launch!
notes.content:
We have come to a great day for us! The day when we are finally ready to leave Early Access! There were countless sleepless nights and a lot of affection invested to conclude this game with a team made up of only 2 brothers (and a big friend on the sound side)! We extended the release date originally imagined so that we could implement suggestions that were very recurring in the community feedback.

More game modes:
[list]
[*] For more traditional racers, it is now possible to run Single Races and experience a traditional race through all tracks available;
[*] For those who like to push yourself to the limit, Time Attack mode will allow you to try harder and harder to beat your best lap (and who knows the best lap of the developer!);
[/list]
And also:
[list]
[*] The new Achievements are now all available for players;
[/list]

Now with this stage over, we are ready to finally launch our game officially, which started as a very small game, and over the early access became a project that made us very proud of the result! Hope you like it!!

For Early Access players:

It was an incredible journey to make this game together with you, and we think that the final result was higher than our expectations (thanks to your constant feedback!). We owe you a lot for raising the level of the game. We wait for you in our next project!

Thanks!

tags.feature: For more traditional racers, it is now possible to run Single Races and experience a traditional race through all tracks available;
For those who like to push yourself to the limit, Time Attack mode will allow you to try harder and harder to beat your best lap (and who knows the best lap of the developer!);
The new Achievements are now all available for players;

notes.title: Tinker Racers update 0.9.12 (Office tracks and release news)
notes.content:
"OK! Are you ready for some great news? Mom and Dad had to travel over the weekend and ended up leaving their office unlocked. God save us if they find out the tracks we built there!”  

Changes in v0.9.12:
[list]
[*] Office tracks are now available!
[*] Boost power up implemented;
[*] Menu navigation improved.
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Resolution drop down fixed;
[*] UI bugs solved.
[/list]

Special notes: 

When we launched Tinker Racers in Early Access, we had a well-defined scope in mind, as described in the Early Access FAQ. In short, the game should offer tracks around 3 environments, "night" mode and a well-balanced score system. On the other hand, we were also completely open to community feedback.  

Imagine our surprise when we saw this little game receiving so much attention and affection from players! There were countless modifications and improvements that would never have been possible or imagined if it weren't for the community involvement in the development process. Here at Rumbora we discussed a lot about what to do about it.  

The reduced initial scope (to fit in our budget) made us take certain strategic decisions that, on one hand, limited us, on the other hand, gave us clarity and focus to honor what we proposed to do. We thought about all the impacts we would face extending Early Access, increasing the price range and doing a deep refactor to implement the most challenging features. It was a very difficult decision. However, now we are happy to announce that we are going to start working on a new project. It will be based on much more solid foundations than the first one, which will allow us to include many features that would be impossible in Tinker Racers.  

Tinker Racers will be released soon and it will look amazing! We are very happy to be able to deliver everything promised to those who bought the game still in Early Access. We know that many games need to be aborted during Early Access for several reasons. However, we had an internal commitment to deliver a nice game at all costs. This means a lot to us and it is a great accomplishment to see that day coming.  

Tinker Racers was published in Early Access at an advanced development stage, and yet we got many benefits by listening to the community. With the next project we want to go further! We are starting it from scratch already open for feedback. In this project, we have a well-defined north, but with far less scope limitations. It will be incredible and you will be part of this journey with us from the very beginning!  

This doesn't mean Tinker Racers will have its development ended after the official launch. Any new feature developed that has synergy with Tinker Racers will be evaluated and implemented in it as well. This only means that we’ll have two active projects, with different directions, but following the same essence.

For those interested in following everything we will be able to create from now on, be sure to follow our studio:  

https://store.steampowered.com/developer/rumbora  
 

Thank you very much!

notes.title: Tinker Racers price update tomorrow!
notes.content:
Tomorrow is time for another important update! The "night tracks" will be available to everyone who reaches a score above 7000!
We really want to thank everyone who played our buggy game in this first month and helped us to improve it more and more throughout the month. With several adjustments and some features implemented, it's time to set the price to $ 3!

Please continue to support us for an even better game at the official launch.
